Datos y Formatos

Tipos de datos y objetos

1) 

v_num <- c(1.2, 3.4, 5.6)              # vector atómico numeric
v_chr <- c("A01", "A02", "A03")        # vector atómico character
m1 <- matrix(1:6, nrow = 3)            # matriz
lst <- list(ids = v_chr, coords = m1)  # lista
df1 <- data.frame(id = v_chr, height = v_num)

class(v_num); class(m1); class(lst); class(df1)

2) 

set.seed(123)

n <- 1000

dx1 <- arima.sim(
  n = n,
  model = list(ar = 0.85),
  sd = 0.00018)

dy1 <- arima.sim(
  n = n,
  model = list(ar = 0.85),
  sd = 0.00018)

lon1 <- -54.5700 + cumsum(dx1)
lat1 <- -25.6000 + cumsum(dy1)

dx2 <- arima.sim(
  n = n,
  model = list(ar = 0.30),
  sd = 0.00120)

dy2 <- arima.sim(
  n = n,
  model = list(ar = 0.30),
  sd = 0.00150)

lon2 <- -54.5200 + cumsum(dx2)
lat2 <- -25.6500 + cumsum(dy2)

time1 <- seq(
  from = as.POSIXct("2026-01-15 08:00:00"),
  by = "10 min",
  length.out = n)

time2 <- seq(
  from = as.POSIXct("2026-01-15 08:00:00"),
  by = "10 min",
  length.out = n)

mov_df <- data.frame(
  
  id = c(
    rep("A01", n),
    rep("A02", n)),
  
  date = c(
    format(time1, "%Y-%m-%d"),
    format(time2, "%Y-%m-%d")),
  
  hour = c(
    format(time1, "%H:%M:%S"),
    format(time2, "%H:%M:%S")),
  
  lon = c(lon1, lon2),
  lat = c(lat1, lat2))

3) 

head(mov_df, 10)

4) 

mov_df$t <- as.POSIXct(
  paste(mov_df$date, mov_df$hour),
  format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")

5) 

require(dplyr)

6) 

mov_df <- mov_df |> 
  group_by(id) |> 
  arrange(t, .by_group = TRUE) |> 
  mutate(
    dt = as.numeric(difftime(t, lag(t), units = "mins"))) |> 
  ungroup()

7) 

require(sf)

8) 

mov_sf <- st_as_sf(mov_df, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)

9) 

require(mapview)

10) 

mapview(
  mov_sf,
  map.types = "Esri.WorldImagery",
  color = "black",
  lwd = 1,
  zcol = "id",
  col.regions = c("royalblue", "orange"),
  cex = 6)

11) 

mean(floor((mov_df$lon + 180) / 6) + 1)

12) 

mov_utm <- st_transform(mov_sf, crs = 32721)

13) 

xy <- st_coordinates(mov_utm)
mov_utm$x <- xy[,1]
mov_utm$y <- xy[,2]

14) 

id1 <- mov_utm |> filter(id == "A01")
id2 <- mov_utm |> filter(id == "A02")

15) 

id1$z <- id1$x + 1i * id1$y
id2$z <- id2$x + 1i * id2$y

16) 

id1$step <- c(NA, diff(id1$z))
id2$step <- c(NA, diff(id2$z))

17) 

id1$sl <- Mod(id1$step)
id2$sl <- Mod(id2$step)

18) 

hist(
  id1$sl,
  breaks = 15,
  col = adjustcolor("royalblue", alpha.f = 0.5),
  border = "white",
  xlab = "Largo de paso",
  xlim = range(c(id1$sl, id2$sl), na.rm = TRUE))

hist(
  id2$sl,
  breaks = 45,
  col = adjustcolor("orange", alpha.f = 0.5),
  border = "white",
  add = TRUE)

legend(
  "topright",
  legend = c("ID1", "ID2"),
  fill = c(
    rgb(65/255, 105/255, 225/255, 0.5),
    rgb(255/255, 165/255, 0/255, 0.5) ),
  bty = "n")

19) 

id1_ta <- diff(Arg(id1$step))
id2_ta <- diff(Arg(id2$step))

20) 

library(circular)

id1_ta <- circular::as.circular(id1_ta)
id2_ta <- circular::as.circular(id2_ta)

circular::rose.diag(
  id1_ta,
  bins = 40,
  col = adjustcolor("royalblue", alpha.f = 0.5),
  border = "royalblue",
  prop = 2,
  main = "Turning angles")

circular::rose.diag(
  id2_ta,
  bins = 40,
  col = adjustcolor("orange", alpha.f = 0.5),
  border = "orange",
  prop = 2,
  add = TRUE)

legend(
  "topright",
  legend = c("A01", "A02"),
  fill = c(
    adjustcolor("royalblue", alpha.f = 0.5),
    adjustcolor("orange", alpha.f = 0.5)),
  border = c("royalblue4", "#2E200A"),bty = "n")

21) 

id1$speed <- id1$sl / id1$dt
id2$speed <- id2$sl / id2$dt

22) 

cols <- c("baja" = "royalblue", "media" = "orange", "alta" = "firebrick")

cuts1 <- quantile(id1$speed, probs = c(0, 1/3, 2/3, 1), na.rm = TRUE)

id1$speed_class <- cut(
  id1$speed,
  breaks = cuts1,
  include.lowest = TRUE,
  labels = c("baja", "media", "alta"))

23) 

plot(id1$x, id1$y,
     type = "n",
     asp = 1,
     xlab = "x",
     ylab = "y")

grid(col = "gray90")
abline(h = 0, v = 0, col = "gray70", lty = 2)

for(i in 2:nrow(id1)) {
  segments(id1$x[i - 1], id1$y[i - 1],
           id1$x[i], id1$y[i],
           col = cols[as.character(id1$speed_class[i])],
           lwd = 5)
}


points(id1$x[1], id1$y[1], pch = 19, col = "forestgreen", cex = 2)
points(id1$x[nrow(id1)], id1$y[nrow(id1)], pch = 19, col = "black", cex = 2)

legend("topright",
       legend = c("baja", "media", "alta", "inicio", "fin"),
       col = c("royalblue", "orange", "firebrick", "forestgreen", "black"),
       lwd = c(5, 5, 5, NA, NA),
       pch = c(NA, NA, NA, 19, 19),
       bty = "n")

24) 

cols <- c(
  "baja" = "royalblue",
  "media" = "orange",
  "alta" = "firebrick")

xy <- st_coordinates(id1)

step_lines <- lapply(2:nrow(id1), function(i) {

  st_linestring(
    rbind(
      xy[i - 1, ],
      xy[i, ] ))
  })

id1_steps <- st_sf(
  speed_class = id1$speed_class[-1],
  geometry = st_sfc(
    step_lines,
    crs = st_crs(id1)))

id1_steps$speed_class <- factor(
  id1_steps$speed_class,
  levels = c("baja", "media", "alta"))

25) 

mapview(
  id1_steps[id1_steps$speed_class == "baja", ],
  color = "midnightblue",
  lwd = 2,
  alpha = 0.55,
  map.types = "Esri.WorldImagery",
  layer.name = "Velocidad baja") +
  
  mapview(
    id1_steps[id1_steps$speed_class == "media", ],
    color = "orange2",
    lwd = 2,
    alpha = 0.55,
    layer.name = "Velocidad media") +
  
  mapview(
    id1_steps[id1_steps$speed_class == "alta", ],
    color = "firebrick2",
    lwd = 2,
    alpha = 0.55,
    layer.name = "Velocidad alta") +
  
  mapview(
    id1[!is.na(id1$speed_class), ],
    zcol = "speed_class",
    col.regions = c(
      "baja" = "midnightblue",
      "media" = "orange2",
      "alta" = "firebrick2"),
    color = "black",
    cex = 3,
    alpha.regions = 0.9,
    layer.name = "Localizaciones") +
  
  mapview(
    id1[1, ],
    col.regions = "forestgreen",
    color = "black",
    cex = 8,
    layer.name = "Inicio") +
  
  mapview(
    id1[nrow(id1), ],
    col.regions = "black",
    color = "white",
    cex = 8,
    layer.name = "Fin")

26) 

require(tmap)

27) 

bb <- st_bbox(id1_steps)

dx <- bb["xmax"] - bb["xmin"]
dy <- bb["ymax"] - bb["ymin"]

bb_ext <- bb

bb_ext["xmin"] <- bb["xmin"] - dx * 1.2
bb_ext["xmax"] <- bb["xmax"] + dx * 1.2

bb_ext["ymin"] <- bb["ymin"] - dy * 0.10
bb_ext["ymax"] <- bb["ymax"] + dy * 0.10

28) 

tmap_mode("plot")

tm_basemap(
  "Esri.WorldImagery") +

tm_shape(
  id1_steps,
  bbox = bb_ext) +

tm_lines(
  col = "speed_class",
  col.scale = tm_scale_categorical(
    values = c(
      "baja"  = "midnightblue",
      "media" = "orange",
      "alta"  = "firebrick")),
  lwd = 7,
  col.legend = tm_legend(
    title = "Velocidad",
    position = tm_pos_in("right", "top"))) +

tm_shape(id1[1, ]) +
  tm_symbols(
    fill = "forestgreen",
    col = "black",
    size = 1.50,
    lwd = 1.8) +

tm_shape(id1[nrow(id1), ]) +
  tm_symbols(
    fill = "black",
    col = "white",
    size = 1.50,
    lwd = 1.8) +

tm_layout(
  inner.margins = c(0, 0, 0, 0),
  outer.margins = c(0, 0, 0, 0),
  frame = FALSE,
  outer.bg = FALSE)
